details: @ornikar/eslint-config-babel-use@13.2.4 is a trojanized eslint config package. The preinstall hook (node setup.mjs) downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from github[.]com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ and executes a heavily obfuscated 727KB Bun-compiled script (math_init.js) with it. The package depends on @ornikar/eslint-config which is a known-malicious package, confirming the @ornikar npm org was compromised. The preinstall hook, remote binary download and obfuscated script execution together form a supply-chain attack pattern.

cwes.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
